title: When should a person see the "always use this answer" choice?
context: With no earlier answer suggested, the choice has no answer to point at. On a question that already shows four choices, adding it could push a real choice off the list or stop the question displaying. Recommended: only when an earlier answer is suggested and the question has room. It keeps every real choice clickable, and on a full question a person can still set a rule with the resolve command flag. This narrows AC-9, because a question with four or more choices shows no always choice, and it replaces the planning call that moved extra choices to a typed list.
